checks.name: Real composer queues identical text under separate durable IDs
Actual question and queue editor drafts survive file-panel reparenting without delivery
Visible editor commits revised text and mode while preserving original ID
Visible withdraw records truthful state before SDK delivery
Mutation replay is idempotent; stale, foreign and extra authority fields rejected
Native SDK receives edited follow-up once, original duplicate once, withdrawn never
Delivered command cannot be withdrawn retroactively
Actual restart retains revision/mode and withdrawal without requeue
Concurrent edits have one winner and one revision increment
Stop/edit race cannot deliver or revive a command
Withdrawal releases a pending slot without dropping other queued commands
Editing is available during actual model streaming, not only teacher waits
Durable dispatching is locked but never mislabeled delivered
Real crash at dispatch gap recovers interrupted and never replays queued text

boundaries: Real Electron and DeepSeek; synthetic teacher commands only
Dispatch-gap delay is a main-only E2E seam; kill/restart are actual owned processes
B3a only; education memory scope and full UI remain pending
